summary: Flathead NF pole tower with cabin, dated 1938; listed as gone by FFLA and firelookout.com. No source describes what remains at the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by two sources; no source describes what remains at the site

events.note: Pole tower with cabin, per firelookout.com

places the lookout in Flathead and Lincoln counties

notes_for_editor: Gone status agrees across the FFLA table and firelookout.com; the 1938 date and elevation rest on the firelookout.com page alone. Coordinates check out roughly: the record point lies about 8 miles ENE of Fortine's town centre (Wikipedia, 48.76167 N, 114.89750 W), close to the page's 'northeast of Fortine'. Do not confuse with 'Locke, Mount' (platform, 48.82833, -114.72700, Gone), a separate entry in the same FFLA table. Two web searches returned only unrelated Flathead lookouts. No staffing, fire or removal-date sources found.
